properties.name: USACE eHydro Ohio River bathymetric survey extents
properties.description: Bounding-box extents of 20 hydrographic survey sounding sets, Ohio River miles 776-976. Extents derived from thinned XYZ sounding coordinates (KYSP-S ftUS -> WGS84). Depths are below Ohio River Datum; NAVD88 offset unavailable.
properties.generator: tsm confluence-hydraulics wiring (bounding boxes from real sounding coordinates; not full survey geometry)

properties.horizontalCRS: EPSG:6475 (NAD83(2011) / Kentucky South, US survey feet)
properties.verticalDatumNote: Soundings are depths below Ohio River Datum in feet. ORD to NAVD88 offset unavailable — not converted, not invented.
properties.provenance: USACE eHydro Azure blob store via public FeatureServer; vendored 2026-10-01; SHA-256 in offline-data/regional/hydraulics/bathymetry/raw/SHA256SUMS.txt
